svg.title: Retrieval augmented generation on Azure
svg.desc: Retrieval augmented generation on Azure. 14 components in 7 groups. Connections: Users to Microsoft Entra ID; Users to Application Gateway (HTTPS); Application Gateway to Private endpoint (get certificate); Private endpoint to Key Vault (TLS certificate); Application Gateway to Container Apps (HTTPS); Container Apps to Private endpoint; Container Apps to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Azure OpenAI (prompt with top results); Private endpoint to Azure AI Search (hybrid query); Azure AI Search to Azure OpenAI (vectorize query); Blob Storage to AI Search indexer (pull documents); AI Search indexer to Azure AI Search (index chunks); AI Search indexer to Azure OpenAI (embed chunks); Container Apps to Application Insights.

text.tspan: A chat app grounds Azure OpenAI answers in an Azure AI Search index that an indexer fills from Blob Storage
